crossRefs.note: Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.
for whom Yahweh loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;
You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,
You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening…

translations.web: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.
translations.bsb: Fathers, do not provoke your children, so they will not become discouraged.
translations.kjv: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.
translations.asv: Fathers, provoke not your children, that they be not discouraged.
